messages:
ashok: Heads-up — finalizing GCP KMS plan for Private deployments. Quick Q: recommended SA bind pattern for keyRing + cryptoKeys with least privilege?

maria: Prefer separating roles: one SA (kms-wrapping-sa) that can Encrypt/Decrypt on cryptoKey and a different SA for admin/rotation. Keep admin SA out of runtime.

kevin: +1. Concrete bindings we use in prod:
```
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding PROJECT_ID --member=serviceAccount:kms-wrapping-sa@PROJECT_ID.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
# rotation/admin SA
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding PROJECT_ID --member=serviceAccount:kms-admin-sa@PROJECT_ID.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.admin
```

ashok: That matches my draft, but two questions: 1) For Private (customer VPC) runtimes we impersonate a bound service account via Workload Identity — do we need iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator anywhere? 2) How do we handle cross-project keyrings for customer-managed keys?

maria: 1) If your runtime needs to impersonate the wrapping SA, the runtime's SA needs iam.serviceAccounts.actAs on the wrapping SA (or use tokenCreator on the proxying SA). Prefer Workload Identity + short-lived tokens instead of long-lived keys.

olivia: 2) For cross-project: give the runtime project SA the explicit cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on the target cryptoKey resource. Prefer resource-level bindings (key vs keyRing) to limit blast radius. Example:
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/KEY_PROJECT/locations/global/keyRings/kr --member=serviceAccount:runtime-sa@RUNTIME_PROJECT.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
```

kevin: Also watch audit logs: you need to enable DATA_ACCESS logging for Cloud KMS to get Encrypt/Decrypt entries. Default ADMIN_ACTIVITY logs won't show data plane ops.

security-bot: Reminder: enable Cloud Audit Logs -> Data Access for the KMS resource and route sink to secure logging project. See https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/audit for details.

ashok: On envelope encryption: our pattern is CEK (AES-256) generated per-tenant, CEK wrapped by KMS (Encrypt) and stored alongside metadata. On rotate: generate new CEK, rewrap stored CEKs with new key version. Any gotchas?

maria: Sounds right. Key gotchas: when rotating keys, Cloud KMS creates new key versions. Use the new version as PRIMARY via `gcloud kms keys set-primary-version` then rewrap CEKs. Keep old versions for decrypt until you finish rewrap.

olivia: Add these to rollout checklist: 
- create new key version
- set new version as primary
- run rewrap job (idempotent, must use primary for new wraps)
- verify audits (Encrypt calls from rewrap job and Decrypt calls for app reads)
- promote and remove old versions after a TTL

kevin: Rewrap job should run from an admin environment with kms.admin or at least cryptoOperator plus IAM to read/store wrapped CEKs. Make rewrap resilient and rate-limited to avoid throttling.

ashok: What about offline backup / key export? We aren't exporting keys; we'll rely on KMS. But need rewrap plan if KMS key compromised — we re-create keys and rewrap CEKs.

maria: Incident notes: if a key is suspected compromised, rotate immediately (create new key ring/key), run rewrap job, revoke any SA tokens as necessary, and check Audit Logs for unexpected Decrypt/Encrypt calls. Notify customers if their tenant CEKs touched.

sre-oncall: Add runbook steps for oncall: commands to list key versions, set primary, check IAM bindings, and confirm data access logs. Quick commands: 
```
# list versions
gcloud kms keys versions list --key=KEY_NAME --keyring=KR --location=global --project=PROJECT_ID
# set primary
gcloud kms keys set-primary-version --key=KEY_NAME --keyring=KR --location=global --version=3 --project=PROJECT_ID
# check bindings
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy projects/PROJECT_ID/locations/global/keyRings/KR/cryptoKeys/KEY_NAME
```

kevin: For logging, ensure logs are retained per compliance (90/365 days depending on customer). Also consider writing an aggregated changelog whenever rewrap completes (who ran it, versions touched).

ashok: Thanks — I'll update the design doc with these SA binding patterns and the rewrap playbook. Will post the draft here for quick review. :thumbsup:

maria: lgtm, also add a test that simulates key rotation and verifies app can still decrypt older wrapped CEKs until rewrap done.

olivia: And include a small integration test that verifies Data Access logs emitted for Encrypt/Decrypt.

security-bot: Note: follow least-privilege for the rewrap job SA — do not give it project Owner.

ashok: filing follow-ups: create IAM templates, add CI job for rotation test, and draft oncall runbook. Will tag people in PR.

maria: thanks!
